scope: P1-A56 classic Gao Shun, Xianzhen/Jinjiu rules and official portrait
selectedVersion: 一将成名经典高顺（群4体力，陷阵／禁酒）

sources.use: 当前官方武将页：群势力4体力；陷阵胜利后本回合仅对拼点目标用牌无距离限制、杀不计次数并无视防具，未赢则不能使用杀；锁定技禁酒令酒视为杀；同时提供574x761经典形象大图。
区分经典高顺与界限突破等异版，并交叉核对经典陷阵／禁酒文本。
按用户指定概念页区分锁定标签、状态技与主动入口；陷阵为State + Active，禁酒为Locked + State。

ruleText.xianzhen: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以与一名角色拼点。若你赢，直到回合结束，你对该角色使用牌无距离限制且对其使用【杀】无次数限制，并无视其防具；若你没赢，直到回合结束，你不能使用【杀】。

implementation.jinjiuProgram: schema 10 mandatory hand-card identity alcohol-hand-as-slash; runtime capability minimum 94, formal content gate rules 105

versionBoundary.replayPolicy: the private opponent Pindian prompt, exact target, win/loss usage and completed state reconstruct from the accepted command prefix
versionBoundary.legacyPolicy: rules v104 keeps Xianzhen disabled and Alcohol native even when package 1.83.0 is loaded; package 1.82.0 does not register Gao Shun

portrait.attribution: Official classic Gao Shun artwork reused only for the user's local experiment under explicit authorization

assertions: Xianzhen exposes one exact private source card and one legal target, then one private opponent-card prompt
winning Xianzhen removes card-use distance only against that target, gives target-only unlimited Slashes and ignores only that target's armor
losing or tying Xianzhen blocks Slash use without blocking unrelated cards
Jinjiu suppresses native Alcohol actions and exposes the same physical cards only as mandatory Slash identities
rules v104 and package 1.82.0 preserve both pre-Gao-Shun boundaries
paused opponent Pindian and completed win replay deterministically
official portrait, both skill texts, active draft and live target state are visible without clipping

excludedVariants: boundary Gao Shun versions with different Xianzhen effects
any later balance adjustment not present on the selected official classic page
deferred: real Windows desktop mouse and keyboard acceptance
